rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; the case has Form W-2 wages of $80,000 (single), so taxable income before the NOL deduction is far above $25,000 and 80% of it exceeds the $20,000 post-2017 NOL: the whole $20,000 is deducted (i172, 80% limitation; f1040s1 line 8a, entered as a negative). The model assumed no other income ('no other income was given'), reading only the Schedule 1 inputs. The case was reworked only by the new s1.state_disability answer (false). Project stands.
